definitions: A large, herbivorous, aquatic mammal native to the Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of Mexico.
A species of manatee (Trichechus manatus) found in the coastal waters of the southeastern United States, the Caribbean, and the northern coast of South America.
examples: The West Indian manatee is an endangered species.
A West Indian manatee was spotted near the shore.
Conservation efforts protect the West Indian manatee.
